title: [PLAY-04] Show and cancel pending listening sessions
body:
## Goal

Show and cancel pending listening sessions

## Requirement

PLAY-04 — see [REQUIREMENTS.md](https://github.com/mziethen/grooveshelf/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Show the scanned record and a countdown until the ten-minute listening threshold is reached.
- [ ] Allow cancellation before a play is recorded; a canceled session must not increase the play count.
- [ ] Show completion or cancellation clearly and keep the display consistent with server state.
- [ ] Define behavior for repeated scans, another record being scanned, and reconnecting or restarting before implementation.

## Dependencies and open decisions

Related: #12, #13 and #14. Reuse the listening-session logic from PLAY-01 rather than introducing a separate timer.

## Status

Accepted for planning; not implemented.

title: [PLAY-05] Correct listening history manually
body:
## Goal

Correct listening history manually

## Requirement

PLAY-05 — see [REQUIREMENTS.md](https://github.com/mziethen/grooveshelf/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add a missed play with a selected physical copy and listening timestamp.
- [ ] Edit an incorrect listening timestamp and remove an erroneous play with confirmation.
- [ ] Recalculate play counts and last-played values consistently after corrections.
- [ ] Distinguish manually entered plays from NFC-generated plays.

## Dependencies and open decisions

Depends on #14. Coordinate album-versus-copy aggregation with #13.

## Status

Accepted for planning; not implemented.

title: [NFC-04] Provide guided tag assignment and reader feedback
body:
## Goal

Provide guided tag assignment and reader feedback

## Requirement

NFC-04 — see [REQUIREMENTS.md](https://github.com/mziethen/grooveshelf/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When an unknown tag is scanned, offer a record selector and confirm the selected association.
- [ ] Show clear visual feedback for successful reads, unknown tags, assignment success, reader disconnection and detectable read errors.
- [ ] Prevent silently assigning a tag already linked to another copy; explicitly resolve reassignment.
- [ ] Allow retrying a failed assignment without creating duplicate associations.

## Dependencies and open decisions

Related: #10, #11 and #12. Extend their integration and assignment logic with a guided interface.

## Status

Accepted for planning; not implemented.

title: [EXPORT-02] Export and restore a complete portable collection archive
body:
## Goal

Export and restore a complete portable collection archive

## Requirement

EXPORT-02 — see [REQUIREMENTS.md](https://github.com/mziethen/grooveshelf/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Export records, albums, metadata, locally stored covers, NFC associations, listening history, notes, ratings, favorites and wishlist entries when supported.
- [ ] Include an archive format version and preserve internal IDs and relationships.
- [ ] Restore the archive to a fresh compatible installation on another Raspberry Pi and verify that collection data and covers remain usable.
- [ ] Validate the archive and report incompatible or corrupt input before modifying the collection.
- [ ] Exclude access tokens and secrets; document archive contents and supported restore behavior.

## Dependencies and open decisions

Related: #28 and #24. OPS-02 covers operational backup; this issue covers portable application-level export and restore. Share restore validation where possible. Required before the first production deployment.

## Status

Accepted for planning; not implemented.

title: [DISCOVER-01] Suggest what to listen to next

## Requirement

DISCOVER-01 — see [REQUIREMENTS.md](https://github.com/mziethen/grooveshelf/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Offer a randomly selected record from the owned collection with cover, artist and album title.
- [ ] Allow choosing among the full collection, never-played records, least-played records and records not played recently.
- [ ] Offer another suggestion and open its details without recording a play.
- [ ] Handle an empty collection or empty candidate set clearly.
- [ ] Use local collection and listening data without requiring paid services; define recency and frequency rules before implementation.

## Dependencies and open decisions

Depends on #3 and #14. Wishlist entries are not playable owned copies.

## Status

Accepted for planning; not implemented.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Apply a selectable date range to time-based statistics and define the local timezone used for month boundaries.
- [ ] Reflect manual history corrections in statistics.

title: [ARCH-01] Prepare the data model for multiple listening stations
body:
## Goal

Prepare the data model for multiple listening stations

## Requirement

ARCH-01 — see [REQUIREMENTS.md](https://github.com/mziethen/grooveshelf/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Represent the current Raspberry Pi reader as one station with a stable identifier.
- [ ] Associate scan events and pending listening sessions with their source station.
- [ ] Keep inventory numbers and physical-copy identities independent of stations.
- [ ] Define repeated-scan and deduplication boundaries with PLAY-01 so future stations do not share timers accidentally.
- [ ] Document extension points for additional stations; initially implement and operate only one Raspberry Pi station.

## Dependencies and open decisions

Related: #10 and #13. Multi-station operation and its management interface remain future work; this issue covers model preparation only.

## Status

Accepted for planning; not implemented.
